verdict.rationale: Brex's own docs describe AI agents that categorize and review spend against policy, write memos and fetch receipts, and auto-match uploaded receipts to expenses. They also describe an audit agent that monitors expenses and ranks potential violations by risk level, so the core of the story is first-party documented. missing for 10: explicit duplicate- or fraud-detection evidence, explicit receipt OCR/line-item reading for card expenses (itemized capture is only documented for bill pay), independent or hands-on corroboration.
